semantics: questions[].drafts: builder drafts, every constraint the text of its field; the request sends numbers parsed from that text and selection limits only when multiple.
questions[].expected.errors: sorted dotted locations (relative to the question list) where QuestionSet rejects it; [] = accepted.
compat[].expected: check_compatibility's report. issues are sorted by (level, question_key, message) and each change's details are sorted, because Python visits option sets in hash order.
compat questions are full API shapes; whole double bounds below 1e16 are ints, as Swift's JSONEncoder sends them.
slugs[]: services/topics.py slugify ('topic' when nothing is left).

casefold[]: [code point, [folded code points]] for every code point whose Python str.casefold() differs from itself (the server compares labels by casefold, code point by code point, with no normalisation). unicode_version is Python's.
